The two surviving children of Aerys II, Viserys and Daenerys Targaryen, fled into exile, and have resided in the Free Cities of Essos ever since.
facts: A red three-headed dragon, breathing red fire on black, (Sable, a dragon thrice-headed gules flammant of the last)

Dragonlord (pre-Doom), Lord of Dragonstone (pre-Conquest), King of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men, Lord of the Seven Kingdoms, Prince of Dragonstone (heir apparent), Prince of Summerhall, Queen of Meereen
Targaryen family: before 114 BC, House Targaryen of Dragonstone: 114 BC, House Targaryen of King's Landing: 1 AC

tarly.summary: House Tarly of Horn Hill is a noble house of the Reach, one of the strongest sworn to House Tyrell. Horn Hill is located in the foothills of the Red Mountains. Their sigil is the striding huntsman on green. Their motto is not revealed in the books, but according to semi-canon sources it is "First in Battle".
facts: A striding red huntsman on green, (Vert, a huntsman striding gules)
Herndon of the Horn and Harlon the Hunter

tarth.summary:
House Tarth of Evenfall Hall is a noble house from Evenfall Hall in the stormlands. The family rules Tarth, a beautiful island northeast of Shipbreaker Bay that controls the Straits of Tarth between the island and mainland Westeros. They are one of the main houses sworn to House Baratheon of Storm's End.

Their blazon is quartered with yellow suns on rose and white crescent moons on azure. Their words are not known. The Lords of Tarth call themselves the Evenstar.
facts: Quartered: yellow suns and white crescents on rose and azure, (Quarterly clockwise, 1st and 3rd rose, a sun-in-splendour or, 2nd and 4th azure, a moon increscent argent)
Lord of Evenfall, Lord of Tarth, The Evenstar, King of Tarth (historical)
Before the coming of the Andals

tawney.summary:
House Tawney of Orkmont is a noble house from the Iron Islands, one of the strongest sworn to Pyke. Their lands are found on the island of Orkmont.

According to semi-canon sources they blazon their arms as a scourge of nettles, red and black, on white.
facts: A scourge of nettles, red and black, on white, (Argent, a scourge sable lashed with nettles gules)

toland.summary:
House Toland of Ghost Hill is a Dornish noble house sworn to Sunspear, one of the House Martell's principal bannermen. Their seat is Ghost Hill.

The Tolands' banner once depicted a ghost. Their current arms, however, depict a green dragon biting its tail on gold, the dragon symbolizing that time has no beginning and no end. Their words have not been mentioned.
facts: A green dragon biting its tail on gold, (Or, a dragon biting its tail vert), Formerly: a ghost

tully.summary: House Tully of Riverrun is one of the Great Houses of the Seven Kingdoms. Lord Hoster Tully, the Lord Paramount of the Trident, rules over the riverlands from the Tully seat of Riverrun. Their sigil is a silver trout leaping on a striped field of blue and mud red, and their house words are "Family, Duty, Honor."
facts: A leaping trout, silver, on a field of blue and mud red, (Paly wavy azure and gules, a trout embowed argent)
Lord of Riverrun, Lord Paramount of the Trident

tyrell.summary: House Tyrell of Highgarden is one of the Great Houses of the Seven Kingdoms, being Lords Paramount of the Mander and the liege lords of the Reach. A large, wealthy house, its wealth is only surpassed among the Great Houses by House Lannister, and the Tyrells can field the greatest armies. Additionally, if they call the ships of the Redwyne fleet, the lords of the Shield Islands, and the coastal lords, they can command a navy that equals if not surpasses the royal fleet of King's Landing.
facts: A golden rose on green, (Vert, a rose or)
High Steward (pre-Conquest), Lord of Highgarden, Lord Paramount of the Mander, Defender of the Marches, High Marshal of the Reach, Warden of the South

tyrell-of-brightwater-keep.summary: House Tyrell of Brightwater Keep is a new noble house in the Reach, and a cadet branch of House Tyrell of Highgarden.
facts: Two golden roses on green, (Vert, two roses or)

uller.summary:
House Uller of Hellholt is one of the great noble houses in Dorne. Their keep, the Hellholt, is in the middle of the Dornish desert.

Their arms are rayonne yellow over crimson. The motto of the house does not appear in the books.
facts: Rayonne yellow over crimson, (Per fess rayonny or and gules)

umber.summary: House Umber of the Last Hearth is a noble house from the Last Hearth in the north. Lord Jon Umber, called "the Greatjon", is sworn to House Stark of Winterfell. The Umber sigil is a roaring giant, brown-haired and wearing a skin, with broken silver chains, on flame-red. According to a semi-canon source, their house words are "Death Before Chains".
facts: A roaring giant, brown-haired and wearing a skin, with broken silver chains, on flame-red, (Gules, a giant roaring brunâtre habited with a skin proper wearing chains broken argent)
Before the coming of the Andals

upcliff.summary:
House Upcliff is a noble house from the Witch Isle off the coast of the Vale of Arryn. According to semi-canon sources, they blazon their arms with a cresting wave, sea green on black. Their words are not known.

The Upcliffs have a sinister reputation.
facts: A cresting wave, sea green on black, (Sable, a wave cresting aquamarine)

vaith.summary:
House Vaith of the Red Dunes is a Dornish noble house. Their seat, also named Vaith, is placed on the river with the same name. West of Vaith are the deep sands of Dorne; the head of House Vaith has the title Lord of the Red Dunes.

Neither their arms nor words appear in the books, but according to a semi-canon source the Vaiths blazon their shield with three black leopards standing on a yellow pile on orange.
facts: Three black leopards standing on a yellow pile on orange, (Tenné, on a pile or three leopards statant sable)

vance-of-atranta.summary:
House Vance of Atranta is one of the two great branches of House Vance in the riverlands, the other being House Vance of Wayfarer's Rest.

Neither their arms or their motto appear in the books. According to semi-canon sources they blazon their arms as quartered, a green dragon on white and a white tower on black. They supported the greens during the Dance of the Dragons, but it is not known whether the green dragon on their sigil is supposed to indicate this choice, as the arms were created before George R. R. Martin decided they supported the greens.

House Vance rules over wider domains and can field a much larger army than their liege lords, House Tully. House Smallwood is sworn to one of the Vance families.
facts: Quartered: a green dragon on white, a white tower on black, (Quarterly, 1st and 3rd argent, a dragon vert, 2nd and 4th sable, a tower argent)

vance-of-wayfarer-s-rest.summary:
House Vance of Wayfarer's Rest is one of the two great branches of House Vance in the riverlands, the other being House Vance of Atranta.

Neither their arms or their motto appear in the books. According to semi-canon sources they blazon their arms as quartered, a black dragon on white, two golden eyes in a golden ring on black. They supported the blacks during the Dance of the Dragons, but it is not known whether the black dragon on their sigil is supposed to indicate this choice, as the arms were created before George R. R. Martin decided they supported the blacks.

House Vance rules over wider domains and can field a much larger army than their liege lords, House Tully. House Smallwood is sworn to one of the Vance families.
facts: Quartered: a black dragon on white, two golden eyes in a golden ring on black, (Quarterly clockwise, 1st and 3rd argent, a dragon sable, 2nd and 4th sable, a two orbs or within an annulet of the last)

velaryon.summary: House Velaryon of Driftmark rules the island of Driftmark, the largest island of Blackwater Bay in the crownlands. Their castles include Driftmark and High Tide. The head of House Velaryon is titled Lord of the Tides and Master of Driftmark. The Velaryons are sworn to Dragonstone. Their arms depict a silver seahorse on sea green. Their words do not appear in the books, but according to semi-canon sources they are "The Old, the True, the Brave".
facts: A silver seahorse on sea green, (Aquamarine, a seahorse argent)
Lord of the Tides, Master of Driftmark

volmark.summary:
House Volmark of Volmark is a noble house from the Iron Islands. Their seat of Volmark is on the island of Harlaw, and they are sworn to the house of the same name. They have large holdings on the island and have a decorated history.

They blazon their arms with a black leviathan on a grey sea. Their words are not known.
facts: A black leviathan on a grey sea, (Cendrée, a leviathan sable)
Lord of Volmark, Lord of Greenshield

waxley.summary:
House Waxley of Wickenden is a noble house from Wickenden in the south of the Vale. They are sworn to House Arryn of the Eyrie.

A Feast for Crows mentions the House's arms as six white candles. A semi-canon source alternatively blazons their arms with three candles, white with red flames, within silver candle holders on a grey field bordered in black. According to semi-canon sources their words are "Light in Darkness."
facts: Six candles, white with red flames, within silver candle holders on a grey field bordered in black, (Cendrée, six candles white in holders argent inflamed gules, within a bordure sable)

waynwood.summary:
House Waynwood of Ironoaks is a noble house from Ironoaks in the Vale of Arryn. They are one of the great noble families sworn to House Arryn.

They blazon their arms with a black broken wheel on green. Their words do not appear in the books.

It is unknown whether the Waynwoods are related to House Wayn.

### Traits

Members of House Waynwood tend to be horse-faced and have brown hair. They are known for their pride and insistence on ceremony.
facts: A black broken wheel on green, (Vert, a broken-wheel sable)

webber.summary:
House Webber of Coldmoat is a noble house from Coldmoat in the Reach. It is sworn to House Rowan. Their lands used to border those of House Osgrey.

Their blazon is a black field with a white, spotted-red spider on a silver web.

House Webber's castle, Coldmoat, can support twenty times as many smallfolk as Standfast. House Webber lands include the Horseshoe Hills, Leafy Lake, and the Chequy Water. The Webber lands contain fields of barley, wheat, and corn, as well as six orchards of apples, apricots, and pears. The Webbers are proud of their horse breeding as well.
facts: A white and spotted-red spider upon a silver web over black, (Sable, a cobweb silver thereon a spider argent spotted gules)

westerling.summary: House Westerling of the Crag is a noble house from the Crag in the northwestern westerlands. They are sworn to House Lannister of Casterly Rock, and are considered among their principal bannermen. Their sigil is six seashells, white on sand. According to semi-canon sources, their words are "Honor, not Honors".
facts: Six white seashells on sand, (Carnation, six escallops argent)

whent.summary:
House Whent of Harrenhal is a noble house from the riverlands. Their seat is the huge castle of Harrenhal, built three hundred years ago by Harren the Black.

They blazon their arms depicting nine black bats displayed over a yellow field. Their words do not appear in the books.
facts: Nine black bats, 4-3-2, on yellow, (Or, nine bats 4-3-2 sable)

wull.summary:
House Wull is the formal name given to the Wulls, the most powerful of the mountain clans from the north. The Wulls inhabit the area west of the Northern mountains along the Bay of Ice.The chief of the clan is known as "the Wull" by his own people, although at Winterfell he is given the style of "Lord Wull."

They blazon their banners with three wooden buckets, brown on blue, with a border of grey and white checks.
facts: Three wooden buckets, brown on blue, with a border of grey and white checks, (Azure, three wooden buckets brunâtre within a bordure chequy cendrée and argent)

wylde.summary: House Wylde of the Rain House is a noble house from the Rain House in the stormlands. It is one of the principal houses sworn to House Baratheon. According to semi-canon sources they blazon their arms with a blue-green maelstrom on gold.
facts: A blue-green maelstrom on gold, (Or, a gurges aquamarine)

yronwood.summary:
House Yronwood of Yronwood is the most powerful house in Dorne after the ruling Martells. Their seat, Yronwood, is the last fortress defending the Boneway; this is reflected in their title Warden of the Stone Way. House Yronwood claimed the title High King of Dorne before the arrival of the Rhoynar, and the head of the house continues to be called the Bloodroyal.

According to semi-canon sources, their motto is We Guard the Way. Their blazon is a black portcullis grill over sand.
facts: A black portcullis grill over sand, (Carnation, a portcullis sable)
